module purpose: neorv32_imem is a word-indexed memory behind a bus request/response record: when IMEM_INIT is true it reads words of a constant image (mem_rom_c) at the word index taken from the request address; otherwise it writes request data into four byte-lane arrays under byte enables and reads them back. A registered read flag (rden) decides whether the read word or zeros is driven on the response data, and the acknowledge is registered from the strobe.

use-case flows.value: write data bytes of a bus write request stored into the addressed word of the byte-lane arrays under their byte enables (IMEM_INIT false)
the word at the requested index (constant image or byte-lane arrays) captured in rdata and returned on the response data when a read was requested
access acknowledge registered from the strobe (read requests only when IMEM_INIT is true) and an error flag tied to '0'
read flag rden and acknowledge forced to '0' while rstn_i is '0'

conceptual assets.concept: Writable memory contents -- the bytes stored in the memory array and returned on later reads (IMEM_INIT false)
conceptual assets.reasoning: In builds where IMEM_INIT is false (imem_ram, line 107; alt_style_c is the constant false at line 38, so only imem_ram_default, lines 110-135, elaborates), a write request stores request bytes in the addressed word: `if (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '1') then` (line 114), `if (bus_req_i.ben(0) = '1') then` (line 115), `mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr)) <= bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0);` (line 116), with lanes 1-3 at lines 119, 122 and 125. The read-out flow returns them: `rdata(7  downto 0)  <= mem_ram_b0(to_integer(addr));` (line 128, lanes 1-3 at lines 129-131). Integrity is Established: a read at an index must return the bytes last written there under their byte enables, and the arrays are assigned only under that write condition. Availability is also Established: each array is assigned only on a rising edge of clk_i under the write condition (line 113), so it holds its content between writes, and it is read on every clock edge (lines 128-131). Confidentiality is not established: no line restricts which request reads a word. mem_ram_b0 to mem_ram_b3 store (CLOCKED_BY clk_i, occurrence 2 of each, lines 116, 119, 122, 125). bus_req_i.data, ben, stb and rw set the content but are fields of the transport request record and are not reported; addr only carries a slice of bus_req_i.addr (line 101) and selects the word (SELECTED_BY addr), so it is secondary. When IMEM_INIT is true the content is the constant mem_rom_c (line 44), which is not a candidate, so that build's stored content has no structural reference here.

conceptual assets.concept: Read data word -- the memory word fetched at the requested index and returned to the requester
conceptual assets.reasoning: The read-out flow captures the addressed word on a rising edge of clk_i: `rdata <= mem_rom_c(to_integer(addr));` (line 81, IMEM_INIT true) or the four lanes at lines 128-131 (IMEM_INIT false), and drives it out by `bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0');` (line 185). The word is delivered through an output to a consumer that is not supplied, so Integrity is Established from lines 81, 128-131 and 185: the requester must receive exactly the word stored at the requested index. Availability is also Established: rdata is refreshed on every clock edge from the current index (lines 80-81, 113, 128-131). Confidentiality is not established: no line restricts which request may read. rdata stores (CLOCKED_BY clk_i, occurrence 4, line 128; also occurrence 2, line 81). bus_rsp_o carries the response of complete transactions (ack, data, err) and bus_req_i the request (addr, data, ben, stb, rw), so neither is an exit or setting point; rdata is the eligible element inside the block that holds the value. addr selects the word (SELECTS rdata) but only carries a slice of bus_req_i.addr (line 101), so it is not listed. The map gives rdata mixed storage because of the alternative-style assignments at lines 95 and 159-162; these do not elaborate because alt_style_c is the constant false (line 38), so in every elaborated build rdata is assigned only on the clock edge.

conceptual assets.concept: Read-valid decision -- whether the previous cycle carried a read request, which decides if the response data carries the memory word or zeros
conceptual assets.reasoning: `rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw);` (line 176) records on each rising edge of clk_i whether a read was requested, and `bus_rsp_o.data <= rdata when (rden = '1') else (others => '0');` (line 185) uses it to decide what the response data carries. Integrity is Established: a wrong decision returns zeros for a requested read or presents the word when no read was requested, so the response data delivered across the boundary no longer matches the read-out flow. Availability is also Established under the RTL conditions: the decision is produced on every clock edge while rstn_i is '1' and forced to '0' while rstn_i is '0' (lines 172-173). Confidentiality is not claimed: line 185 limits when the word appears, but no line ties this to an access right. rden stores the decision (CLOCKED_BY clk_i, occurrence 3, line 176); it also computes it (GATED_BY bus_req_i.stb and bus_req_i.rw at the same occurrence), and stores takes precedence. The flow graph lists rden as a constant-valued CONTROL-ONLY source because its right-hand side holds only gating operands; the RTL at line 176 shows its value is the read-request predicate, not a constant. The acknowledge (lines 178, 180) is a field of the transport response record and is not reported.

conceptual assets.concept: Write qualification -- whether a bus request writes the memory, and which byte lanes it writes
conceptual assets.reasoning: Writes into the memory arrays require `(bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '1')` (line 114) and a per-lane enable such as `bus_req_i.ben(0) = '1'` (line 115; lanes 1-3 at lines 118, 121, 124). The integrity of the writable memory contents depends on this decision: a wrong decision writes a lane that was not requested or drops a requested write. The decision is formed inline in the if conditions from fields of bus_req_i, a transport record carrying complete transactions (address, write data, byte enables, strobe, read/write), and no internal signal holds it, so no eligible declaration survives the transport rule and the list is left empty.
